plain: make this legal: you can't bring food into the cinema
legal: No food shall be brought into the cinema.

plain: writing a legal letter to my landlord - the heating has been broken for 2 weeks and you haven't fixed it
legal: The heating has been inoperative for two (2) weeks, and you have failed to repair it.

plain: legal threat mail to the airline - you lost my suitcase on 4 April and I want $1,200 compensation within 30 days or I'm suing
legal: You lost my suitcase on 4 April, and I hereby demand compensation of $1,200 within thirty (30) days, failing which I shall commence legal proceedings against you.

plain: turn into contract language: the designer gets paid $2,000 when the logo is finished
legal: The Client shall pay the Designer $2,000 upon completion of the logo.

plain: can you make this sound like a lawyer wrote it? We don't give refunds after 14 days.
legal: No refunds shall be issued after fourteen (14) days.

plain: formal legal email to the gym: I'm cancelling my membership from today, stop taking money from my account
legal: I hereby terminate my membership with effect from today, and you shall cease taking any payments from my account.

plain: Convert to legal wording: Staff must wear ID badges at all times.
legal: All staff shall wear identification badges at all times.

plain: lawyer speak pls -> if the tenant leaves early they lose the deposit
legal: If the Tenant vacates the Premises before the end of the term, the Tenant shall forfeit the deposit.

plain: write a legal complaint to the hotel - the room you gave us was dirty and the air conditioning didn't work for our whole 3-night stay
legal: The room that you allocated to us was unclean, and the air conditioning did not function throughout our stay of three (3) nights.

plain: Rewrite as legal: I want my $85 back for the concert that got cancelled.
legal: I hereby request a refund of $85 in respect of the concert that was cancelled.

plain: legal version: we'll deliver the furniture within 10 working days
legal: The Seller shall deliver the furniture within ten (10) working days.

plain: make it legal-sounding — you agree not to tell anyone about our product plans
legal: The Recipient shall not disclose the Company's product plans to any person.

plain: draft a legal notice to my neighbour: your car has blocked my driveway every morning this week, move it or I'll have it towed
legal: Your car has obstructed my driveway every morning this week; you are required to remove it, failing which I shall have it towed.

plain: Please convert this into legal language. The supplier has to replace broken items for free.
legal: The Supplier shall replace any broken items free of charge.

plain: legal mail to my employer - I still haven't been paid for March and it's now May 10
legal: As at May 10, I have not yet received payment of my wages for March.

plain: make this sound official: no one is allowed on the roof without permission from the building manager
legal: No person shall access the roof without the permission of the building manager.

plain: Lawyer version please: If you damage the rental bike, you pay for the repair.
legal: If the Renter damages the rental bike, the Renter shall pay for the repair.

plain: write this as a formal legal demand: you owe me $340 for the tickets I bought for you, pay me by Sunday
legal: You owe me the sum of $340 in respect of the tickets that I purchased on your behalf, and I hereby demand payment by Sunday.

plain: legal email to the seller - the watch I bought is fake and I want a full refund of $420 or I'll report you to the platform
legal: The watch that I purchased from you is counterfeit, and I hereby demand a full refund of $420, failing which I shall report you to the platform.

plain: make legal: the client can cancel the booking up to 72 hours before without paying anything
legal: The Client may cancel the booking up to seventy-two (72) hours in advance without incurring any charge.

plain: convert to legalese: we may change these rules at any time
legal: The Management reserves the right to amend these rules at any time.

plain: write a legal letter to the school - my daughter was left alone outside after school on 3 October and nobody called me
legal: My daughter was left unsupervised outside the school after classes on 3 October, and no one contacted me.

plain: Make this formal & legal: The renter must return the keys by noon on the last day.
legal: The Renter shall return the keys no later than noon on the final day of the rental period.

plain: legal threat to my contractor - you took a $3,000 deposit 2 months ago and haven't started, refund it in 7 days or I'm going to court
legal: You received a deposit of $3,000 two (2) months ago and have not commenced the work; you are required to refund that deposit within seven (7) days, failing which I shall commence court proceedings.

plain: legal language pls: Members who don't pay fees for 2 months will be suspended.
legal: Any Member who fails to pay fees for a period of two (2) months shall be suspended.

plain: turn this into a legal complaint to the bank: you blocked my card without warning while I was abroad and I couldn't pay for my hotel
legal: You blocked my card without warning while I was abroad, and as a result I was unable to pay for my hotel accommodation.

plain: contract wording: the photographer keeps the copyright but the couple can use the photos for personal purposes
legal: The Photographer shall retain the copyright, provided that the Couple may use the photographs for personal purposes.

plain: Legal style -> I'm returning the sofa because it's not the colour I ordered.
legal: I hereby return the sofa on the ground that it is not of the colour that I ordered.

plain: sound like a lawyer: Anyone caught stealing will be banned and reported to the police.
legal: Any person found to have committed theft shall be banned and reported to the police.

plain: make this legal: I agree to pay back the $5,000 you lent me by December 31
legal: The Borrower shall repay the loan of $5,000 to the Lender by December 31.

plain: Formal legal version for an email to customer support: my order #77310 never came and it's been 3 weeks
legal: My order number 77310 has never been delivered, and three (3) weeks have elapsed since it was placed.

plain: legal: you must give us 2 weeks notice before you quit
legal: The Employee shall give the Company not less than two (2) weeks' notice prior to resignation.

plain: rephrase in legal language - Please don't contact me again on this number.
legal: I hereby request that you do not contact me again at this telephone number.

plain: legal notice to tenant: you have 30 days to pay the $2,600 you owe or we will start eviction
legal: You are required to pay the outstanding sum of $2,600 within thirty (30) days, failing which we shall commence eviction proceedings.

plain: make it lawyerly: The shop isn't liable for items left behind.
legal: The Shop shall not be liable for any items left on the premises.
